chunks: And those who take God and His Prophet and the faithful as their friends are indeed men of God, who will surely be victorious.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Party of God (Hizb Allah) and what is their promised outcome?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of Mubahala or the declaration of Wilayah, establishing the triad of God, the Prophet, and the Ahl al-Bayt as the core of divine authority. It underscores the concept of 'Tawalla' (loyalty) as the defining characteristic of the 'Party of God,' promising them ultimate victory over their adversaries. This alignment serves as a theological foundation for the Imamate, distinguishing the true believers who follow the divinely appointed leaders.
